tooltip.realshrooms.mycena_chlorophos.1: Right-click when ripe to harvest. Shears: +1 and faster regrowth.

tooltip.realshrooms.mushroom_substrate.1: Keep it moist: water within 4 blocks, or rain.

tooltip.realshrooms.mushroom_substrate.3: Any species grows here, even without trees.
tooltip.realshrooms.chanterelle_mycelium: A living network. A ripe mushroom on top feeds it.
Lives in tree roots, feeds on water and soil. Dies without trees.
Spreads over soil, fruits at its edge. Silk Touch moves it.
